note: curl-gate.py's AUDIT_LOG shape (hooks/curl-gate.py:171-192). Each row is joined to ONE archive row by `match_cmd` and is written `offset_s` after THAT row's own timestamp, so the join is exercised at +5 s inside the +/-15 s window without attributing anything else that session did. Only the api.example.test rows are joined — the cdn.example.test curl rows are deliberately left unattributed so a curl candidate still survives the hook_raised partition and reaches its gate.
